player_prompt.intro: Uxazulula iphazili yeSokoban. Ungumdlali futhi udinga ukucindezela wonke amabhokisi emigomeni. Uma useduze nebhokisi, ungaligudluza ngokuhamba ngendlela efanayo. Awukwazi ukucindezela ibhokisi ngodonga, futhi awukwazi ukudonsa ibhokisi. Ebhodini, izinto zimelwe njenge: - Umdlali (wena) uvela njengo 'P' - Izindonga zimelwe ngo '#' - Amabhokisi amelwe ngo 'X' - Imigomo engenalutho iboniswa ngo 'O' - Amabhokisi emigomeni abonwa ngo '√' Ungasebenzisa futhi u- [w] phezulu, u- [a] ngakwesobunxele, u- [s] phansi, no- [d] ngakwesokudla.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukuhamba okufakiwe akulandeli ifomethi efanele. Sebenzisa [up], [down], [left], [right] noma [w], [a], [s], [d].
